acceptance.description: Matrix covers four capability groups across Codex, Claude Code/Desktop, OpenCode Desktop, and Cursor with first-party citations; within workspace lifecycle it separately covers import, create, remove from app list/archive, and physical disk/worktree delete.
Report separates directly documented facts, inference, and documentation gaps.

Repository audit separately identifies actual Electron implementation for import, create, remove from app list/archive, and physical disk/worktree delete; distinguish PRD target, partial state, and actual implementation with code references.
Report recommends a coherent product baseline and sequenced next slices with risks without implementing or changing approved contracts.

argv: from pathlib import Path; import re; p=Path('docs/research/workbench-feature-landscape.md'); s=p.read_text(); required=['## 벤더 기능 비교','## 현재 저장소 구현 범위','## 이 앱에 필요한 제품 기준선','## 출처','| **Import:','| **Create:','| **Remove from app list / archive**','| **Physical delete:','| **우측 아티팩트 패널**','| **도구 호출·승인·결과**','| **Skills / MCP / plugin 목록**']; assert all(x in s for x in required); assert s.count('https://') >= 12; bad=[u for u in re.findall(r'\[[^]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)',s) if not u.startswith(('https://','http://','#','mailto:')) and u.split('#',1)[0] and not (p.parent/u.split('#',1)[0]).resolve().exists()]; assert not bad, bad
